page.overview:
Who is Ebecca D'Antonio?

is the eldest daughter and heiress of a prominent family of Kahad.

Ebecca, according to Wick, seems "lovely", at least on paper.

Ebecca was born the daughter of an old man who owned lands with vineyards of special alchemical properties. She had a younger brother too, but as they grew up he renounced his claim to their land, leaving her with a very desirable inheritance.

At some point before the execution of Thjazi Fang Ebecca was betrothed to Light Priest Wicander Halovar, a union arranged by his mother Iris and his grandmother, Photarch Yanessa Halovar.
